definitions.content: the coherent system of units adopted and recommended by the General Conference on Weights and Measures (CGPM)

notes.content:
The SI is based at present on the following seven base units:

[cols="3", options="header,unnumbered",headerrows=2]
|===
.2+| Quantity 2+| SI base unit | Name | Symbol

| length                    | metre    | stem:["unitsml(m)"]
| mass                      | kilogram | stem:["unitsml(kg)"]
| time                      | second   | stem:["unitsml(s)"]
| electric current          | ampere   | stem:["unitsml(A)"]
| thermodynamic temperature | kelvin   | stem:["unitsml(K)"]
| amount of substance       | mole     | stem:["unitsml(mol)"]
| luminous intensity        | candela  | stem:["unitsml(cd)"]
|===

definitions.content: système cohérent d'unités adopté et recommandé par la Conférence générale des poids et mesures (CGPM)

notes.content:
Le SI est fondé actuellement sur les sept unités de base suivantes:

[cols="3", options="header,unnumbered",headerrows=2]
|===
.2+| Grandeur 2+| Unité SI de base | Nom | Symbole

| longueur                    | mètre      | stem:["unitsml(m)"]
| masse                       | kilogramme | stem:["unitsml(kg)"]
| temps                       | seconde    | stem:["unitsml(s)"]
| courant électrique          | ampère     | stem:["unitsml(A)"]
| température thermodynamique | kelvin     | stem:["unitsml(K)"]
| quantité de matière         | mole       | stem:["unitsml(mol)"]
| intensité lumineuse         | candela    | stem:["unitsml(cd)"]
|===
